texto: Monsters now drop Gear Gacha of their level: weapons, cape, accessory, gems and Light/Heavy/Robe armor, with the official odds (normal 22.8%, Quality 2%, the best 0.2%).
Lv1-60 gear sells to NPC shops for 1,000-6,000 gold. Mount Lucky Bags now give Ride Feed and mounts (the strongest 0.1%). Mark Stone and Mark Portal Scroll left the Mall. Drop rate x1, weekends x1.1.
We moved to a new server in America. Visit aoforever.tech (English/Spanish) to create your account and use My account: characters, password and the events calendar.
Faction change at the Census Angel (Lyceum). Summons no longer walk through walls, Dense Forest portals no longer send you back and the minimap shows one dot per NPC.
